transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Um… I guess the main thing is my eating’s been kind of a mess lately. I don’t mean to make it sound dramatic, but I stopped keeping up with my food tracking, and then I was skipping actual meals for days—mostly just coffee and protein bars.

I didn’t really notice how much it had changed until my clothes started fitting looser… kind of hanging on me. So, yeah, I figured I should probably come in before I let it get worse. Is that the sort of thing I should be bringing up?
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

I… I don’t know if “afraid” is the right word. I mean, I’d rather not gain a bunch of weight, sure, but I don’t think I’m panicking about it or anything. It’s more like… I noticed the looseness in my clothes and it seemed like a sign I wasn’t really taking care of things. Does that make sense?
Do you ever have episodes where you feel like you eat an unusually large amount of food in a short period of time?

Not really in the sense of, like, eating a huge amount all at once. It’s kind of been the opposite, honestly. My eating just got… disorganized, I guess. I stopped caring about tracking it, and then I’d go days without real meals—mostly coffee and protein bars.

I didn’t even realize how off it had gotten until my clothes were hanging looser. I know that probably sounds not great.
Have you been losing your appetite?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t know if it’s appetite exactly or just me not paying attention to eating, but it got pretty off track. I stopped caring about tracking food, and then I’d go days without real meals—mostly coffee and protein bars.

I guess I didn’t realize how much I was skipping until my clothes started hanging loose. I know that’s probably not ideal.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yeah… I mean, a bit. I don’t want to make it sound overly dramatic, but after the sponsor questioned my judgment, it kind of… knocked the air out of me.

I went home and just sat in my apartment feeling really hollow and ashamed. I was crying over emails I normally would’ve just handled, which felt embarrassing. I know everyone has bad days, but… it felt heavier than that, I guess.
When you look at your body, do you feel like you’re overweight even though your clothes are fitting looser?

Um… no, I don’t think so. I mean, I notice the clothes being looser, but I don’t look in the mirror and think I’m overweight or anything like that. It’s more like I realize I probably haven’t been taking care of myself as well as I should. Does that make sense?
Have you lost interest in eating?

Yeah… I guess I have. Not like food disgusts me or anything, but I just stopped really caring about it. I wasn’t tracking meals anymore, and then it turned into going days without anything that felt like a real meal—just coffee and protein bars because they were easy.

I didn’t really think of it as “lost interest” at first, but… yeah, my eating got pretty off the rails. My clothes started feeling loose before I even really admitted I wasn’t eating normally.
Have you also lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I’m trying not to overstate it, but I haven’t really wanted to do the things that usually help me feel like myself.

Like hiking, editing photos, even logging meals… and there’s this woodworking project sitting in my garage that I normally would be excited to work on, but I just haven’t wanted to touch it. Which feels strange, because those things usually keep me grounded, you know?
Have you been feeling this down most days for at least two weeks?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but after the sponsor questioned my judgment, it was like… the bottom kind of dropped out.

I was just sitting in my apartment feeling really hollow and ashamed. I’d be looking at emails I normally could’ve handled and just… crying over them. So, yes, most days for at least a couple weeks, I think that’s fair to say.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of wanting to die?

Um… yeah. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound like I was trying to be dramatic or anything, but… I did start thinking that people at work would probably be better off if I just didn’t wake up.

And after that meeting, I… I said out loud that maybe I should just walk into traffic and be done with it. I know that sounds bad. I’m sorry—I’m not trying to alarm you, I just… that’s what came out.
Are you intending to kill yourself right now?

Right now… no, I don’t think I’m intending to do it right now.

I mean, I did have those thoughts—like everyone at work might be better off if I just didn’t wake up—and after that meeting I said I should walk into traffic and be done with it. I know that’s serious. I just… I don’t want you to think I’m trying to make a scene. But no, sitting here right now, I’m not intending to kill myself.
Before this started, were you intentionally trying to lose weight?

No… not intentionally. I mean, I’ve tracked food before and tried to be healthy, so I guess it could look like that, but this wasn’t me trying to cut weight or anything.

I just kind of… stopped caring. I wasn’t doing real meals for days, mostly coffee and protein bars, and then my clothes started feeling loose before I even really noticed. That’s actually part of why I came in, because it felt like my eating had gone completely off the rails.
Did your loss of interest in eating start around the same time as feeling depressed?

Yeah… I think it was around the same time. I don’t want to overstate it, but when I started feeling really low, food just kind of stopped mattering.

I wasn’t keeping up with my tracking or making real meals like I normally would. I’d go days mostly just having coffee and protein bars, and then my clothes were suddenly hanging loose before I really registered it. That was part of why I came in, honestly—my eating felt like it had gotten completely out of control.
